Use the FDI tooth numbering system ONLY (11-18, 21-28, 31-38, 41-48).
Do NOT use Universal numbers 1-32.

Task: find abnormal teeth and assign ONE diagnosis from:
Impacted, Caries, Deep Caries, Periapical Lesion.
Only list teeth that clearly show one of these abnormalities.
If none, write None.

Answer in exactly this format:
Findings:
<FDI>: <diagnosis>
<FDI>: <diagnosis>
Total abnormal: <count>
Confidence: High/Medium/Low

Example:
Findings:
18: Impacted
16: Caries
36: Deep Caries
Total abnormal: 3
Confidence: Medium
